source.note: Hand-authored from the mock (palette/fonts/HUD/juice/camera) + the locked feel doc (feel params). This is the contract Phase C gates check against; it is the source of truth, the parser is verified to match it.

global.note: HUD font; pixel display face. mock: .hud { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace }.

elements.note: Annotation A. 22px, white text w/ 3px black drop; ×NN / total in #ffd166. Apple icon idle-bobs.
Annotation C. Optional / hidden in story mode. Red pulse dot in last 10s.
Annotation B. Max 3 hearts (magenta #ff4d8d fill); lost slot stays as empty pip so layout never shifts.

pixelPerfect.note: upscaleRT MUST be false (HUD-crispness fix): true rasterizes the Screen Space-Camera HUD into the 256x144 RT then upscales it -> blurry text, and the ui-conformance hudCrispness check fails. The verified demo scene currently ships m_UpscaleRT:1 (true) — that is the bug the fix targets; the contract pins false.

camera.note: Concrete one-screen static framing, read from the demo Main Camera + PixelPerfectCamera + Camera2DSetup. orthographicSize 4.5 is the AUTHORED Camera half-height (= refResolutionY/(2*assetsPPU) = 144/32); with worldPosition y=4.5 it puts the world origin at the bottom edge; x=8 centers a 16-unit-wide screen so the frame spans x in [0,16], origin bottom-left. The framing gate enforces this AUTHORED value (captured in EDIT mode by `loombridge capture` as camera.authoredOrthographicSize) — it is NOT a hard runtime value: PixelPerfectCamera OVERSCANS the live orthographicSize at play time when the Game view isn't exactly 16:9 with cropFrame off (e.g. ~5.85 in a taller window), and that runtime value is recorded in screen-rects.json but never enforced. backgroundColorHex #2a1f4d = rgb(0.165,0.122,0.302), the dark-night clear color. Build from THESE values — do not open the demo.

playerAnchor.note: ACCEPTED (Phase F reconcile): Tiderunner ships a STATIC one-screen camera, so the mock's 40% 'lead-the-look' anchor (Annotation I) does NOT apply per-frame — it presumed a FOLLOWING camera. With cameraMode=static the framing gate treats the player-anchor check as informational (pass + note), not a warn. The 40% target is retained for reference only.

framing.note: Annotation I. 16x9 tiles visible, 256x144 native @ 5x = 1280x720. No vertical pan — slice reads in one screen.

physics.note: 60 Hz. Required for the dash-distance target to be hittable: dashTime 0.15s = exactly 9 physics steps -> dashSpeed 18.75 x 0.15 = 2.8125u. At Unity's default 50 Hz, 0.15s = 7.5 steps and the dash quantizes to 2.625/3.0u (out of band). Set Project Settings > Time > Fixed Timestep = 0.0166667. See game-polish-2d/references/feel-mechanics.md.

shortHopApex.note: realized plateau of the canonical 6-tick tap (SHORT_HOP_CANONICAL_TAP_TICKS; live diag 6t saturates at 1.405u). The old 0.72u derived from jumpCutMultiplier 0.5 alone and predates the tick canonicalization: it is unreachable under the canonical tap for any controller that also satisfies jumpApex and timeToApex.

dashDistance.note: = dashSpeed 18.75 x dashTime 0.15; the 3.0u was an arithmetic slip.

dashTrail.note: Annotation D. 3 ghost copies behind player while dash active.

landingDust.note: Annotation E. 4 dust particles on touchdown/launch, +/-6px X spread, fade over 240ms. Every grounded landing.

fruitPop.note: Annotation F. On pickup: swap to Collected.png 6-frame burst, scale 1.0->1.4->0, +1 score punch, 6 gold sparkles radial.

hitStop.note: Annotation G. On saw/spike contact: pause all tweens 6 frames (100ms), player flashes white 1 frame, then screen shake fires.

screenShake.note: Annotation H. Trauma model: 4px amplitude, perlin XY offset, 180ms exponential decay. Triggers on hit ONLY — NOT on landing.

parallax.note: Annotation J. Sky x0.3 (stars, slow drift) -> Hills x0.6 (silhouette) -> Foreground x1.0 (tiles + actors). Vertical drift on far layer only. continuityThresholdU 1.6: the Sky backdrop's per-step center may drift at most 1.6u between trajectory samples; a larger jump is a teleport/snap that tears the parallax (coverage gate CONTINUITY check).

cues.note: Short ascending arpeggio; replaces the mock's coin_05.wav with a procedurally-generated clip.

audio.note: Procedural retro 8-bit SFX, generated with numpy → 16-bit PCM .wav (CC0, same procedural-provenance story as the PIL-generated sky/hills — no external asset sourcing). A drop-in SfxPlayer singleton (pooled AudioSource) plays them and exposes PlayCount; the manifest gate confirms the SfxPlayer GameObject is present in-scene, and a runtime assertion checks SfxPlayer.PlayCount > 0 after a collect/jump. See game-polish-2d/references/audio.md.

win.buildRule: all-fruit (ACCEPTED): GameManager.isWin flips on score >= totalCoins. Reaching the flag (WinLevel()) remains a secondary win trigger.
win.note: Phase F reconcile: the build's all-fruit rule (score >= totalCoins) is now the ACCEPTED win rule. The mock framed the flag as the goal, but collecting all fruit is the consciously-adopted primary objective; reaching the flag stays as a secondary win trigger. The earlier reach-flag/all-fruit mismatch is resolved in favor of all-fruit.

reachability.note: Geometric envelope slack for the reachability gate. verticalMarginU 0.5 adds half a unit above jump/launch apex; horizontalMarginU is omitted so the gate derives it from the feel budget (dashDistance + runSpeed x airtime). Closes the teleport-completion hole: every collectible must sit inside the movement envelope, not just be teleportable onto.

render.note: Playable demo videos should fill the Game-view screenshot; unintended black bars/boxed camera output fail.

platformer.note: Platformer terrain is top-cap row plus body/fill rows; capped tiles must not repeat vertically.

states.name: spawn
states.description: Player at spawn, no input yet — establishes the look/composition baseline.
states.probe: Enter Play; sample the first frame after the scene is ready.

states.name: hazard
states.description: Player adjacent to a hazard mid-arc — exposes hazard readability + framing under motion.
states.probe: Drive the player toward a saw/spike; capture when player overlaps the hazard's screen-space halo.

states.name: movement
states.description: Player mid-dash or mid-jump — captures the juice + camera under motion.
states.probe: Trigger a dash or full jump; capture mid-trajectory (3rd dash frame, or apex).

states.name: win
states.description: Win/end-state reached — exposes the final modal/composition + HUD final state.
states.probe: Reach the flag (or collect-all-fruit per `win.rule`); capture after the win modal/state appears.
